# QuieterWaterfalls

> Moved out of `CLAUDE.md` on 2026-10-13. Text is verbatim; `[verified]` marks and dates are as originally recorded.

- **Source:** `src/QuieterWaterfalls/`
- **Ships:** `Zenderal - Quieter Waterfalls.esp`
- **FormID block:** none (overrides only)

## What it does

**GENERATED by `src/QuieterWaterfalls/tools/01-quieter-waterfalls.py` — never hand-edit `SoundDescriptors/`.** 72 SNDR overrides (every EditorID matching `aterfall|WaterRapids`), `StaticAttenuation` = live winner + 6 dB (`EXTRA_DB`; higher = quieter, absent = 0). Why: `Reverb and Ambiance Overhaul - Enderal.esp` (RAO, load 227) wins 67 of them and LOWERED attenuation on many — distant loops most (`AMBWaterfallLargeDistantLPSD` 5.29→2, `…MediumDistantCloseLPSD` 5.29→1, `…MediumDistantLPSD` 7.93→0). Waterfalls have **no category of their own** (they share `AudioCategoryMuteSubmerged 0F23BB` / RAO's `_00E_RAO_AudioCategoryAmbient 00080D` with cave drips, wind, ship creaks), so a category volume can't target them. Winner set from a scan of every active plugin for waterfall EditorIDs: only Skyrim/FS, `Audio Overhaul Skyrim.esp` (204, fully overridden by RAO — the script asserts AOS never wins) and RAO. `Quieter Ark Temple.esp` edits only placed refs in `CapitalCityUpperTemple` — no overlap. Masters: Skyrim + FS + RAO (RAO's category FormKey), so the engine enforces load-after.
